# Holy Hornet UAV Systems

> Holy Hornet is an independent UAV (drone) consultancy and systems company based in Europe (Netherlands). It designs, integrates and operates unmanned aircraft for surveillance, inspection, mapping, logistics, agriculture and counter-drone defence, and trains teams to fly them. Slogan: "Advanced UAV solutions for a safer tomorrow."

- Website: https://holyhornet.com/
- Contact: info@holyhornet.com or https://holyhornet.com/contact.html
- Region: Europe

## Pages

- [Home](https://holyhornet.com/): Holy Hornet designs, integrates and operates UAV systems for surveillance, inspection, mapping, logistics, agriculture and counter-drone defence across Europe.
- [Solutions](https://holyhornet.com/solutions.html): UAV strategy and consultancy, systems integration, mission planning, drone operations, payload and sensor integration, and team training from Holy Hornet.
- [Industries](https://holyhornet.com/industries.html): Drone capability for infrastructure, energy, public safety, security and counter-drone, agriculture, media, logistics, research and environmental survey.
- [Systems](https://holyhornet.com/systems.html): 26 Holy Hornet UAV simulation and control projects: a 102-drone swarm formation show, multi-UAV path planning with Grey Wolf Optimiser, RRT* planning, PID, LQR, MPC, NMPC, backstepping, sliding-mode and fuzzy flight control, SLAM, reinforcement learning, counter-UAS tracking and full hexacopter, octocopter and wind-turbine inspection models.
- [Simulations](https://holyhornet.com/simulations.html): (sign-in and approval required) Perching UAV, an interactive simulator that runs in the browser (https://holyhornet.com/projects/perching-uav/): a drone that finds a compatible steel surface or bar, attaches with electropermanent magnets or a claw, verifies the grip, switches its motors off to work as a sensor station, then checks battery, wind, airspace, motors and release before detaching. All results are simulated. SkyShield, a live browser demo of a passive drone detection and tracking console (https://holyhornet.com/projects/skyshield/): simulated radar, RF, Remote ID, camera and acoustic sensors fused into one airspace picture with alerts; detection only, a development prototype with no field results yet. Moving platforms, a browser simulator (https://holyhornet.com/projects/moving-ecosystem/) of drones that launch from and land on moving trucks, ships and robots: relative navigation, platform and deck-motion prediction, quiescent-period landing, fleet coordination; all results simulated, not flight-tested. AICN, an animal intelligence and conservation platform for Tanzania and Zanzibar (https://holyhornet.com/projects/aicn/): livestock tracking with smart collars and drones, marine animal and reef monitoring with drones and an ROV, AI alerts reviewed by people, role-based access; runs in the browser on a digital twin, all data simulated. Falcon Intelligence, a falcon records, tracking, health observation and recovery platform for falcon owners, falconers, breeders and falcon hospitals (https://holyhornet.com/projects/falcon-intelligence/): digital identity, tracker flight analysis against each bird's own baseline, observations for human follow-up rather than diagnosis, lost-falcon recovery cases with expiring share links, role-based access; runs in the browser, all data synthetic, no real tracker connected and no trained AI model yet. SkyTherm, an autonomous soaring UAV research simulator (https://holyhornet.com/projects/skytherm/): 6-DOF glider flight model, atmosphere with drifting thermals, wind shear and turbulence, thermal detection and centre estimation with uncertainty, an explainable soaring autopilot, a 3-D digital twin, research experiments and a validation report; the Python backend runs in the browser, all results simulated, nothing flown. AOM-DIS, an airport operations management and decision intelligence platform for Amsterdam Schiphol (https://holyhornet.com/projects/aom-dis/): strategic demand and scenarios, D-7 to D-0 forecasts with nine models and a leakage-safe backtest, a tactical replay of any day with alerts and an event log, demand against runway capacity, a flight-level digital twin, post-operations accuracy and root-cause reports, and traceable insights; built on real historical Schiphol schedules and flights from January to April 2022, the Python backend runs in the browser, capacity figures are assumptions, cancellations are inferred, decision support only, not air traffic control. DeepFlight AI, a GNSS-denied autonomous navigation research simulator (https://holyhornet.com/projects/deepflight/): a drone flying indoors without GPS on visual-inertial odometry, with a localization integrity monitor that limits movement as uncertainty grows, place recognition and relocalization after a lighting failure, mapping, uncertainty-aware route planning, fault injection and an assistant grounded in the session's data; the Python backend runs in the browser, all results simulated, nothing flown. HolyHornet Flapper, an engineering platform for a bird-inspired flapping-wing UAV (https://holyhornet.com/projects/flapper/): unsteady blade-element aerodynamics on flexible wings, a crank-rocker flapping mechanism with a driven twist linkage, a dynamic motor, gearbox and crank model, 6-DOF flight with a cascaded autopilot, trim and stability analysis, parameter sweeps, a 3-D digital twin, failure injection with a wing-park glide fail-safe, and components selected from published data; the Python engine runs in the browser, all results simulated, nothing built or flown. HolyHornet Counter-UAS Intelligence, a research and evaluation platform for counter-drone detection and tracking (https://holyhornet.com/projects/counter-uas/): simulated daylight, low-light and thermal cameras, radar, acoustic and RF bearing sensors over eight scenarios; a CFAR baseline and CNN classifiers that separate drones from birds and aircraft; three multi-object trackers with explained track decisions; EKF sensor fusion; precision, recall, false-alarm, HOTA, MOTA and IDF1 metrics; a 3-D digital twin and a validation report; detection, tracking and evaluation only, with no engagement or interception function; the Python engine runs in the browser, all results simulated, nothing tested with real sensors. HH-FMS, a flight management system for airline operations (https://holyhornet.com/projects/fms/): schedules and aircraft rotations with conflict checks for aircraft, maintenance, runways and crew duty limits, live flight tracking, fleet, crew and airport management, dispatch with fuel planning, alternates, weather, NOTAMs, a release workflow and PDF briefings, METAR and TAF, operational alerts, analytics and reports, machine-learning delay and cancellation forecasts with confidence and explanations, what-if scenarios and replay of past traffic; the Python backend runs in the browser on a simulated two-airline operation, dispatch outputs are planning support only, all flights simulated. QuadLab Pro, an engineering workbench for designing, checking, simulating and analysing real quadcopter builds (https://holyhornet.com/projects/quadlab/): a component library with every specification traced to its source and labelled as manufacturer data, measurement, estimate or user entry, a 3-D assembly with clearances and centre of gravity, hardware compatibility checks, a wiring and port map, hover power, flight time and thrust margin from published bench tests, PX4 and ArduPilot parameter proposals exported for QGroundControl and Mission Planner, a 6-DOF flight simulator, flight-test campaigns with test cards and a safety gate, and analysis of PX4 ULog, ArduPilot dataflash and MAVLink telemetry logs with reports; the Python backend runs in the browser and projects stay in the visitor's browser, performance figures are estimates, and the vehicle link, live telemetry and AI assistant are in the Windows desktop application only. INTEGRA SYSTEMS PRO, a software and hardware integration engineering workbench (https://holyhornet.com/projects/integra/): customer requirements with traceability and a coverage matrix, an architecture designer with explained interface validation, hardware and software inventories, CAN and serial analysis, test rigs and SIL/HIL test management with engineer approval, log correlation and root-cause workflows, fault-injection scenarios for autonomous systems, releases with a computed gate and two-person approval, customer sites and signed acceptance, and fifteen engineering reports; the Python backend runs in the browser on fictional demo data, hardware access, Git, automated test execution and the AI assistant are desktop-only. AEROS OPS PRO, a flight operations engineering platform for UAV development teams (https://holyhornet.com/projects/aeros-ops/): aircraft and component-level hardware integration with compatibility validation and configuration revisions, aircraft readiness derived from recorded evidence and independent approvals, a fourteen-stage flight-test campaign lifecycle with test cards and acceptance criteria that cannot pass without their measurements and evidence, mission planning with geofence validation and simulation, live telemetry and post-flight log analysis, engineering issues with retest and independent closure, maintenance and reliability, field deployment readiness, customer demonstrations, operator training with internal training records, and PDF and Excel reports; the Python backend runs in the browser on a fictional demonstration dataset with flights from the built-in simulator labelled as simulation; MAVLink links to PX4 and ArduPilot need the Windows desktop application; the platform never arms or starts a mission.
- [Education](https://holyhornet.com/education.html): Practical UAV and pilot courses: drone engineering, aerial photography, remote pilot licence (RPA-L) theory, private pilot licence PPL(A) theory, specific category operations and systems engineering.
- [About](https://holyhornet.com/about.html): Holy Hornet is an independent UAV consultancy and systems company in Europe that advises on, integrates, operates and develops drone systems.
- [Contact](https://holyhornet.com/contact.html): Contact Holy Hornet about drone consultancy, choosing an aircraft from our fleet, systems integration, UAV operations or training. Email info@holyhornet.com.

## Services

- UAV strategy & consultancy: Requirements, technology evaluation, buying support, capability roadmaps and independent technical advice.
- Systems integration: Aircraft, payloads, radio links, ground stations and data workflows set up to work as one system.
- Mission planning: Operating concepts, site surveys, mission design, risk review and field workflows your team can repeat.
- UAV operations: Professional flights and data collection, carried out with the right authorisations and within the rules.
- Payload & sensor integration: Day, night, thermal, mapping and specialist sensors matched to what the mission needs to see.
- Training & capability: Practical training, operator workflows and system familiarisation for your own team.

## Courses

- UAV Engineering & Design: How drones are designed and built, from airframes and propulsion to power systems, components and testing.
- Aerial Photography & Cinematography: Plan and capture great aerial images using composition, camera settings, movement and careful flight preparation.
- Remote Pilot Licence (RPA-L) Theory: Aviation principles, airspace, weather, human factors and safe procedures. The exact syllabus depends on the licensing framework that applies to you.
- Specific Category UAV Operations: Planning and safety for operations beyond the open category, including risk, mitigations and paperwork where needed.
- UAV Systems Engineering: Model, simulate and control UAVs in MATLAB and Simulink, from PID to model predictive control, reinforcement learning, SLAM and swarms.
- Private Pilot Licence PPL(A) Theory: The theory subjects for the aeroplane private pilot licence, from how a wing flies to instruments, air law, weather and navigation.

## Industries

- Infrastructure & construction: Progress records, inspection, surveying, site overviews and views of hard-to-reach structures.
- Energy & utilities: Inspecting lines, towers, turbines and pipelines, with thermal checks and mapping.
- Public safety & emergency: Fast situational awareness, search support and aerial views for responders, where authorised.
- Security & counter-drone: Perimeter watch, site awareness and protection against unwanted drones, within the law.
- Agriculture: Crop spraying and seed spreading with terrain-following drones that cover big fields fast.
- Film, media & production: FPV and stabilised aerial footage for demanding commercial and creative productions.
- Logistics & delivery: Heavy-lift drones that carry equipment and supplies to sites that are hard to reach by road.
- Research & technology: Prototype aircraft, sensors and integration support for new uses of unmanned systems.
- Survey & environment: Mapping land, coastlines and habitats, and monitoring change over time.

## Notes

- Aircraft specifications are manufacturer figures; flight time depends on payload, battery and weather.
- Course details, certification and regulatory fit are confirmed with Holy Hornet before enrolment.
